// ZBrush SubTool collision check (first mode) - PURE ASCII source.
// Generated by zscript/generate_macro.py - edit the generator, not this file.
// Chinese strings are built at runtime via StrFromAsc (the ZScript compiler
// strips non-ASCII literals). Compatible with ZBrush 2022.0.5 / 2025.0.1.
// Each SubTool is SELECTED, solo-shown and exported to sub_<i>.obj, because
// OBJ export writes every visible SubTool and the selected one cannot be
// hidden. Work dir must have NO spaces.

  [VarSet,s_note_launched,[StrMerge,#s_note_launched,[StrFromAsc,231],[StrFromAsc,168],[StrFromAsc,141],[StrFromAsc,229],[StrFromAsc,128],[StrFromAsc,153],[StrFromAsc,227],[StrFromAsc,128],[StrFromAsc,130]]]

[RoutineDef,SaveVis,
  [VarSet,vCount,[SubToolGetCount]]
  [If,(vCount>256),[VarSet,vCount,256]]
  [VarSet,vi,0]
  [If,(vCount>0),
    [Loop,vCount,
      [VarSet,gStatus(vi),[SubToolGetStatus,vi]]
      [VarInc,vi]
    ]
  ]
]

// Show ONLY SubTool #keep (keep must already be the selected SubTool).
// Change only the eye bit 0x01; folder / boolean bits stay intact.
[RoutineDef,ShowOnly,
  [VarSet,vi,0]
  [If,(vCount>0),
    [Loop,vCount,
      [VarSet,vSt,[SubToolGetStatus,vi]]
      [If,(vi=keep),
        [If,((vSt&1)=0),[SubToolSetStatus,vi,(vSt+1)]]
      ,
        [If,((vSt&1)=1),[SubToolSetStatus,vi,(vSt-1)]]
      ]
      [VarInc,vi]
    ]
  ]
  [IUpdate,1,1]
]

[RoutineDef,RestoreVis,
  [VarSet,vi,0]
  [If,(vCount>0),
    [Loop,vCount,
      [SubToolSetStatus,vi,gStatus(vi)]
      [VarInc,vi]
    ]
  ]
  [IUpdate,1,1]
]

[RoutineDef,ShowNote,
  [NoteIButton,#s_note_okbtn,,,,,,,,,0xffffff,,,]
  [VarSet,dummy,[Note,noteMsg,,,0x1f1f1f,,,,,,,,]]
]

[RoutineDef,WriteSmallFile,
  // writes #noteMsg (ASCII) to #subPath; reuses countMem as buffer
  [MemDelete,countMem]
  [MemCreate,countMem,64,0]
  [VarSet,countBytes,[MemWriteString,countMem,#noteMsg,0]]
  [MemResize,countMem,(countBytes-1)]
  [MemSaveToFile,countMem,#subPath,1]
  [MemDelete,countMem]
]

[RoutineDef,RunCollisionCheck,
  [RoutineCall,InitStrings]
  [If,([IExists,"Transform:Edit"]) && ([IGet,"Transform:Edit"]==0),
    [VarSet,noteMsg,#s_note_edit]
    [RoutineCall,ShowNote]
    [Exit]
  ]
  [VarSet,subCount,[SubToolGetCount]]
  [If,(subCount<2),
    [VarSet,noteMsg,#s_note_few]
    [RoutineCall,ShowNote]
    [Exit]
  ]
  [If,(subCount>256),[VarSet,subCount,256]]
  // Remember selection + visibility, then export each SubTool on its own
  [VarSet,gOrigSel,[SubToolGetActiveIndex]]
  [RoutineCall,SaveVis]
  [VarSet,vCount,subCount]
  [VarSet,ei,0]
  [Loop,subCount,
    [VarSet,vi,(ei+1)]
    [NoteBar,[StrMerge,#s_progress,vi,"/",subCount],0]
    [SubToolSelect,ei]
    [VarSet,keep,ei]
    [RoutineCall,ShowOnly]
    [VarSet,subPath,[StrMerge,#gWorkDir,"sub_",ei,".obj"]]
    [If,[FileExists,#subPath],[FileDelete,#subPath]]
    [FileNameSetNext,#subPath]
    [If,[IExists,"Tool:Export"],[IPress,"Tool:Export"]]
    [VarInc,ei]
  ]
  [NoteBar,#s_progress_done,0]
  [SubToolSelect,gOrigSel]
  [RoutineCall,RestoreVis]
  // count.txt: lets the engine ignore stale sub_*.obj from older runs
  [VarSet,subPath,[StrMerge,#gWorkDir,"count.txt"]]
  [VarSet,noteMsg,[StrMerge,"",subCount]]
  [RoutineCall,WriteSmallFile]
  // mode.txt: first = quick, all = full
  [VarSet,subPath,[StrMerge,#gWorkDir,"mode.txt"]]
  [VarSet,noteMsg,#gMode]
  [RoutineCall,WriteSmallFile]
  // Launch engine: frozen exe (no Python needed) first, bat as fallback
  [VarSet,exePath,[StrMerge,#gWorkDir,"bin/ZBCollisionEngine.exe"]]
  [VarSet,batPath,[StrMerge,#gWorkDir,"run_detect.bat"]]
  [VarSet,firstSub,[StrMerge,#gWorkDir,"sub_0.obj"]]
  [If,[FileExists,#firstSub],
    [If,[FileExists,#exePath],
      [ShellExecute,#exePath]
      [NoteBar,#s_note_launched,0]
    ,
      [If,[FileExists,#batPath],
        [ShellExecute,#batPath]
        [NoteBar,#s_note_launched,0]
      ,
        [VarSet,noteMsg,[StrMerge,#s_note_noexe,#exePath,#s_note_noexe2,#gWorkDir]]
        [RoutineCall,ShowNote]
      ]
    ]
  ,
    [VarSet,noteMsg,#s_note_exportfail]
    [RoutineCall,ShowNote]
  ]
]

[IButton,???,#s_tip,
  [IShowActions,0]
  [IConfig,2022]
  [RoutineCall,RunCollisionCheck]
,,1,,,]
